emails.body:
Dear Daman chandra Ji,

Thank you for taking the time to speak with us today. It was great understanding your pharmaceutical wholesale and distribution business, and how your B2B ordering currently flows through your sales team, WhatsApp, and Marg ERP.

As discussed, here is a quick recap of how ZoTok can help:

1. Structured WhatsApp Ordering for Retailers
Today, a lot of order and quotation communication happens over personal WhatsApp chats with no central record. ZoTok brings this onto your official WhatsApp number with an intelligent catalog - your retailers can view products, check ledger balance, select quantities, and receive an order estimate, all natively within WhatsApp.

2. Order Capture from Any Format
We understood that many of your retailers still write orders on paper and share a photo over WhatsApp. ZoTok can read these images (and text-based orders) and convert them into structured orders, which are then pushed directly into your Marg ERP - removing manual re-entry for your team.

3. Sales Team Order Consolidation
For orders your salespeople collect from retailers via calls or WhatsApp groups, ZoTok provides a simple order summary flow - your salesperson enters or accepts the order, submits it, and it flows into the ZoTok order section for bulk upload to Marg, cutting down manual Excel work.

4. Marg ERP Integration (Communication Layer Only)
As clarified on the call, ZoTok does not generate invoices or replace Marg - it sits purely as a communication layer, capturing orders on WhatsApp and syncing them to Marg via our SFTP integration, after which invoices are shared back with your retailers over WhatsApp.

5. Customer Re-engagement & Campaigns
For retailers who haven't ordered in a while (e.g. the last two months), ZoTok can send personalized nudges and campaign messages directly to their WhatsApp number, helping you revive dormant accounts and drive fresh activity.

Hello Mangeysh Sir,

Clickable product journey (self-navigate): FMCG Journey (https://main.d316ym2oexcryf.amplifyapp.com/projects/Haldirams/index.html)

ZoTok for Maganlal — how it fits your process

New Retailer Onboarding via Facebook/Instagram → WhatsApp
Running Meta ads but have no WhatsApp conversion mechanism. Every ad click that doesn’t convert is a lost lead. ZoTok adds a Click-to-WhatsApp CTA:
Retailer clicks the ad → lands on Maganlal’s official WhatsApp → AI qualifies (what do you sell, where are you, what do you carry) → KYC collected (GST, location, business details) → lead profiled and routed to the right salesperson for approval → once approved, they’re onboarded and get a self-service menu for ordering, schemes, and product queries.

Retailer order collection → distributor mapping → Order Edits / Approval confirmation
Your salesperson visits a retailer, collects their order (handwritten note, voice note, or WhatsApp message) → ZoTok AI reads it and maps each line item to Dr. Smith’s SKU master (using the lingo and short codes your retailers actually write, not just OCR) → draft order created with the retailer’s correct price (segmented by customer/distributor margin, from Tally) → sent for ASM/SM approval via the ZoTok PWA → once approved, order confirmed to retailer with the final quote → distributor receives the order for fulfilment → retailer can confirm, modify, or ask questions before the order is locked.
For retailers who prefer to order themselves: the same flow works via WhatsApp self-service — they browse the catalog, place an order, and the same approval and fulfilment process runs.

Salesperson field ops — beat plan, attendance, order capture, performance tracking
Area manager sets up weekly/monthly beat plans in the ZoTok backend → salesperson types “Zoe my plan” each morning on WhatsApp → list of retailers to visit, with location → check-in at each retailer location (time and GPS stamped) → order captured on behalf of the retailer → day closure report sent automatically to the area manager.
Performance reports: per salesperson, per day/month — orders collected, value, locations visited, targets vs. achievement. Downloadable from ZoTok dashboard. Can also be pushed to Google Sheets for custom reporting in whatever format your management uses.

Retailer secondary bill collection + scheme validation
Retailer photographs their purchase invoice from the distributor → sends to Dr. Smith’s WhatsApp number → ZoTok validates: which line items are Dr. Smith products? Which are eligible for the scheme? Is this a duplicate invoice? Is it authentic? → eligible scheme value calculated → retailer gets instant confirmation: “Your invoice of ₹X has been validated. Eligible value: ₹Y. Your next reward milestone: ₹Z.”
Maganlal gets a dashboard: how many retailers participated, total secondary turnover, scheme payouts due.

Payment collection — outstanding reminders from Tally
For distributors with outstanding → automated WhatsApp payment reminders based on invoice age and outstanding amount — segmented (e.g., overdue > 30 days, > ₹50,000) → distributor responds with promise-to-pay date → auto-tracked. Your accounts team stops making 50 calls a day.

Suggested next step
We’ll build a clickable journey using your products so you can see exactly how your process would look on ZoTok. Let's meet next week to allow us to showcase the journey and collect your feedback.

Thank you again for the time to allow us showcase our product offering.

Regards,

VP – Sales & BD

We understand the consideration around the ₹15,000/month subscription. We would like to clarify that ZoTok is not positioned as a basic WhatsApp messaging or chatbot platform.

- AI-Powered Inputs: Text, voice and image-based business inputs can be converted into structured information for processing.
- Ongoing Platform: The subscription covers the SaaS platform, workflow execution, integration, monitoring, maintenance and support.
- Scalable: The same platform can be extended to additional use cases such as re-orders, invoices, payments, outstanding follow-ups, collections and customer/distributor engagement.

Why ₹15,000/month?
The comparison should not be made only with the subscription price of basic WhatsApp platforms. Those platforms may primarily provide messaging, broadcasting or chatbot capabilities.

ZoTok's value is in connecting:
WhatsApp → AI → Business Workflow → ERP → Customer

Therefore, the ₹15,000/month is an ongoing technology and automation investment, not simply a WhatsApp subscription.

Our objective is to reduce manual effort, improve processing accuracy, accelerate operations and create a scalable automation layer around your existing business systems.

We propose starting with the agreed use case, measuring the business value and progressively expanding the automation based on your requirements.

Dear Ankit Ji,

Thank you for the time last week — and for reconnecting. As promised, here is the updated scope document incorporating everything we discussed, including the WhatsApp group feature that wasn't in the September 2025 proposal.

Updated Scope for Ambit Biomedix

Customer Communication via WhatsApp (SFTP Integration)
Your invoices, credit notes, and ledger files are placed in a shared SFTP folder by your billing system → ZoTok automatically picks them up → reads the customer details → sends the relevant document to the right customer on WhatsApp. No manual effort from your team after setup.

Payment reminders: based on invoice due dates read from the SFTP folder, ZoTok sends automated payment reminders to customers on WhatsApp at configured intervals.

Customer self-service: customer types "my invoice" or "my outstanding" in a conversation with your WABA number → AI fetches and sends the relevant documents instantly.

WhatsApp Group Order Capture (New — Added to Scope)
Your sales team and customers already communicate on WhatsApp groups. ZoTok adds an AI listener to those groups:
→ Customer writes their order in the group (free text, handwritten note photo, or voice note)
→ AI listener reads it, maps items to your product/SKU catalog
→ Structured order created automatically on ZoTok
→ Your team reviews, edits if needed (price, quantity), and accepts
→ Order confirmation sent back to the customer in the group

Your team stops manually re-entering orders from WhatsApp groups into the system.

New Lead Management — Facebook/Instagram/Website to WhatsApp
Leads from Facebook, Instagram, and your website land on your official WABA number via Click-to-WhatsApp → AI qualifies the lead (product interest, inquiry type, contact details, urgency) → structured lead profile created in ZoTok → your sales team sees a prioritised call list with full conversation context.

For document-heavy inquiries: brochures, specifications, and quotations can be sent via WABA within the 24-hour conversation window. All documents tracked in the ZoTok dashboard.

AI is trained on your knowledge bank (product documents, FAQs, pricing structure) — first-level queries answered automatically. Complex queries escalated to your team.

ZoGrow Digital Expert
If you'd like your campaigns managed end-to-end: our digital expert sets up Facebook/Instagram campaigns with WhatsApp CTAs, creates ad creatives (with your approval), runs A/B testing, manages lead funnels, and sends weekly performance reports. Optional — you can manage campaigns yourself if preferred.

Compared to the September 2025 proposal, this updated scope adds: WhatsApp group order capture and the lead management journey. The SFTP integration and customer communication remains the same core. Commercial to follow once you've reviewed the scope.

ZoToK Enterprise Deck

Please do review and let us know if you’d like to schedule a follow-up call to walk through the scope and the updated commercial.

Thank you, Ankit Ji.

emails.body:
Dear Aryan Ji and Naveen Ji,

Thank you once again for taking the time to connect with us and for the detailed discussion during the product walkthrough. Please find the attached commercial proposal for your reference and consideration.

The discussion helped us understand the key opportunity areas for SUPASAC, particularly around lead generation, lead qualification, WhatsApp campaigns, product catalogue engagement and conversational automation.

As discussed, ZöTok can act as a WhatsApp-first conversational and execution layer on top of your existing Tally ecosystem, enabling your team to manage customer conversations and leads without changing the way customers currently engage with SUPASAC.

Based on our discussion, the key workflows we see for SUPASAC are:
- AI-led Lead Capture & Qualification – Capture enquiries from WhatsApp and qualify prospects based on requirement, quantity, location, customer type and other parameters.
- Automated Lead Follow-ups – Create automated journeys for new, warm and unresponsive leads, including retry mechanisms.
- Product & Catalogue Automation – Automatically identify whether a customer is enquiring about bags, T-shirts or a specific product and share the relevant catalogue/images.
- WhatsApp Campaigns – Run targeted campaigns to your customer base with CTA-based engagement and funnel-level visibility.
- Conversational Product Enquiries – Allow customers to ask questions naturally on WhatsApp and receive relevant product, pricing and catalogue information.
- Tally Integration – Connect relevant business information from Tally to enable a more structured customer communication workflow.
- Lead Self-Registration – Qualified institutional leads can be guided through the required information/KYC process before being handed over to the sales team.

The larger objective is to convert your existing WhatsApp communication and campaign activity into a structured, measurable and automated lead-to-conversion journey, while keeping WhatsApp as the primary customer interface.

The implementation includes WhatsApp automation setup, workflow configuration, lead journey setup, catalogue configuration and implementation assistance.

Reference Resources:
- Product Demos: https://www.zotok.ai/zoknow
- Enterprise Overview Deck: https://tinyurl.com/ZoTokContext
- ZoTok Case Studies: https://www.zotok.ai/caseStudies

We believe this can be particularly valuable for SUPASAC given the existing WhatsApp campaign activity and the opportunity to automate the journey from Lead → Qualification → Product Engagement → Follow-up → Sales Conversion.

Looking forward to taking this ahead with the team and aligning on the implementation scope and next steps.

Instantly respond to dealer and customer enquiries on WhatsApp, including WhatsApp group-based communication, using automated workflows. This reduces manual follow-ups and ensures faster responses to customers and distributors.

2. GenAI WhatsApp Knowledge Bot
A 24×7 AI assistant that automatically shares product details and pricing, answers dealer or customer queries, and captures B2B order requirements directly on WhatsApp.

3. WhatsApp-Based Order Capture
Distributors and retailers can place primary and secondary orders directly through WhatsApp using simple text or images. ZoTok’s AI engine can recognize order messages and help your team create and process orders quickly from the dashboard.

Segment your customers based on activity such as Active vs. Dormant dealers.
This helps you send targeted messages like:
- New product launches
- Special offers
- Payment reminders for pending balances

5. WhatsApp Group Order & Query Management
Automatically capture orders from WhatsApp groups in any format (text, images, voice notes, or Excel) and convert them into structured orders. Get real-time estimates, instant order confirmations, and a centralized view of all group conversations while reducing manual effort.

Hi Akshay,

Thank you for the time today, and for being so direct about where ZoTok can genuinely help — it made the conversation far more useful.

Here's a quick recap of what we understood:

- You're 100% B2B, no active B2C or retail plans for now
- Leads currently flow through Excel → email to Spocs / Dealers → phone follow-up, also tracked in Salesforce
- Two lead sources sit outside your team's control: the internationally-managed website, and social media marketing — so a WhatsApp CTA at the point of capture isn't viable right now
- You have ~500–600 channel partners and ~110 people across BD and sales nationally
- WhatsApp is already used informally in groups today, but nothing tied to approvals, pricing, or discounting
- Order-to-cash / commerce automation is explicitly out of scope for now

Based on this, here's how we see ZoTok mapping to your problem statements:

Core Use-Case Solutions Discussed

1. Automated Lead Nudges via Google Sheet Sync: Rather than relying on manual email forwarding from weekly web dumps, ZoTok can auto-sync with your Google Sheets/Excel dumps. Incoming leads automatically receive an initial product catalog nudge and a 2-way conversation flow on WhatsApp.

2. 2-Way Agentic AI Profiling: ZoTok AI conducts initial pre-qualification (asking relevant location, product interest, and requirement details). Qualified leads are then mapped and assigned directly to your sales team/Salesforce, saving valuable time for your BD team.

3. On-Ground Event Lead Capture (Zoe Card Scanner): During conferences and ground events, reps can snap a photo of visiting cards into an internal WhatsApp group using @Zoe add new lead. The AI OCR parses card details into your CRM and sends an instant, branded welcome message to the prospect on the spot.

4. WhatsApp Group Intelligence (AI Listener): A designated ZoTok AI listener can join your internal dealer or sales groups to track unread/delayed queries (>24 hours) and surface key conversation signals (such as price negotiations or technical queries) directly to leadership.

5. Lightweight SFTP Catalog Sync: Product brochures, technical specs, and lead-time updates can be maintained via secure folder uploads without requiring complex, deep ERP API integrations.

- Step-by-step flow for the above workflows discussed

Thank you for the time on Friday, and for the thoughtful questions — especially around adoption and how this lands with your sales team internally. That's exactly the kind of thinking that makes a rollout actually work.

Here's a quick recap of what we covered:

- Live walkthrough of our in-progress Vadilal project — AI parsing handwritten, multilingual POD notes, matching them against invoices, and flagging shortages or damage automatically
- Handwritten order digitization: tested against 5,000+ samples, currently at 85-90% accuracy across regional handwriting and product synonym variations (similar to what we've built for ITC Classmate)
- India Gate's lightweight example — a WhatsApp number salesmen can query directly for their own KPI performance, pulled from an existing Google Sheet

Pain points and workflows we discussed, which we'll carry into the journey document for your review:

Salesperson absenteeism / smart basket — on days a beat is missed, retailers in that area get a WhatsApp nudge with a predictive suggested order based on past ordering patterns, which they can edit and confirm directly; some accounts have seen 17-18% incremental revenue recovered from otherwise-missed beats

Dormant / bottom-pyramid retailer activation — engaging retailers who are costly to visit in person (small ticket sizes, low frequency) through WhatsApp-based ordering, schemes, and offers instead

Handwritten and voice-note order structuring — converting free-text, voice notes, or handwritten orders into structured, SKU-mapped orders that get routed to the correct distributor for acceptance and edits

POD / delivery-proof digitization — as shown live for Wadi Lal: parsing handwritten, multilingual delivery notes, matching them to invoices, and flagging shortages or damage automatically instead of waiting on physical paperwork

AI group listener for leadership visibility — a number added to relevant WhatsApp groups (operations, sales, dispatch) that surfaces signals like price negotiation, invoice requests, or delivery complaints without requiring anyone to manually monitor every group

Salesperson WhatsApp-based operations — attendance/check-in, beat planning, order capture, and new retailer onboarding, all without requiring the sales team to leave WhatsApp or adopt a separate app

On the adoption question you raised: as Girish mentioned, companies like Adani Wilmar and Haldiram have found it works best when WhatsApp ordering is set as an explicit target for the sales team rather than left as an optional channel — happy to go deeper on how that's been structured for other accounts if useful.

ZoToK Enterprise Deck

Next steps:

1. We'll send over detailed journey/wireframe visualizations built around the specific problem statements above, so you have something concrete to evaluate and share internally
2. On your end, it would help to validate internally and identify 2-3 use cases that feel like the right low-effort starting point
3. As Girish noted, we'd recommend a lightweight pilot approach (SFTP/Excel-based exchange rather than deep SAP integration) to get moving quickly and iterate from there

Please let us know if anything comes up as you think this through internally — happy to jump on a call anytime.

Thank you again for your time.

Regards,
Anshul Shrivastav
VP – Sales & BD

Hi CK Sharma Ji & Sudhakar ji,

Thank you for the time on Saturday, and for being direct about where things stand — it helps us build something that's actually useful rather than overlapping with what you already have.

Here's a quick recap:

- You currently run SAP, along with an existing DMS, SFA, and Interact for retailer WhatsApp communication
- The gap we identified together: Interact operates as a one-way broadcast tool, while ZoTok's agentic AI enables genuine two-way conversations — retailers can respond, place orders, upload invoices, and get real answers, not just receive messages
- We landed on three use cases sufficient for a pilot: retailer engagement, order booking (mapped directly to the correct distributor), and invoice-based interaction
- You'd prefer a lightweight SFTP-based integration over deeper API integration to start, which keeps things simple on your DMS side
- Karnataka as the proposed pilot market, with retailer counts to follow once scope is finalized

We also walked through a few relevant workflows from similar FMCG rollouts that we'll build into the scope document for your review:

Invoice upload with reward validation — retailer photographs and sends an invoice, AI validates format, line items, and distributor mapping within seconds, flags any mismatches, and pushes qualifying retailers toward milestone-based rewards (Not part of Pilot Scope)

Smart basket for uncovered beats — on days a salesperson can't cover a scheduled beat, retailers in that beat get a WhatsApp nudge with a predictive order suggestion; this drove meaningful conversion in accounts where no orders were otherwise happening (Not part of Pilot Scope)

Retailer self-onboarding on WhatsApp — new retailer fills details, GST/KYC verification happens conversationally, and once approved they're auto-mapped to the right salesperson/distributor with a self-service ordering menu

Retailer order booking & mapping to distributor — structured orders (from free text, voice notes, or handwritten notes) get parsed, matched to SKUs, and routed to the correct distributor for acceptance/edits on WhatsApp itself

Retailer Engagement , Push campaigns with milestone tracking — targeted nudges (e.g., scheme reminders) with tracking visibility into delivery, views, and engagement & orders so your team can see actual ROI rather than a shoot-and-hope broadcast

We'll structure the scope document around these workflows mapped to your three chosen use cases, plus:

1. Scope document covering the pilot solution, testing-phase plan for Karnataka specifically

We understand budget discipline is front of mind, and we'll keep the pilot commercials tightly scoped rather than positioning this as a parallel cost alongside your existing tools.

We'll have both documents to you by Tuesday, and propose connecting Wednesday or Thursday to walk through them together. Please loop in anyone else from your team who should be part of that conversation.

Dear Vinoth & Raj Varma Ji,

Thank you for taking the time to connect with us today and for the engaging discussion around ZoTok.

It was helpful to understand Ravel Electronics' current process and the areas where you see an opportunity to improve sales and customer engagement.

Based on our discussion, we understand the key areas of concern to be:
- Lead Capture & Consolidation: Bringing leads from WhatsApp and other external sources into a single platform for better visibility.
- Cold Lead Follow-up: Ensuring leads do not get missed and enabling systematic follow-ups until closure.
- Lead Assignment: Automating or streamlining lead allocation to the appropriate salesperson based on defined parameters such as geography or territory.
- Sales Activity Tracking: Providing visibility into salesperson interactions and follow-up activities against each lead/customer.
- WhatsApp-led Engagement: Using WhatsApp as a familiar channel for product queries, customer communication, lead qualification and follow-ups.
- Customer Support & Service: Extending the same conversational layer for customer queries, complaints and ticket management.

As discussed, ZoTok can act as a +1 conversational layer over your existing systems, without replacing the current backend applications. The immediate focus can be on addressing the lead management and follow-up gap, and subsequently expanding into other relevant use cases based on your business priorities.

Reference : zotok.ai/zotokcontext

We would be happy to take this discussion forward with your HOD/stakeholders and demonstrate the relevant workflow specifically around Ravel Electronics' lead management requirements.

Thank you once again, and we look forward to the next discussion.

Hi Mehar,

Thank you for the time last week, and for laying out the requirement so clearly. It helped us focus the scope on what your client actually needs. I am attaching the Scope of Work, Solution Deck and Illustrative Journey link with this email for your overview.

Scope of Work Document: Attached

Here's a quick recap of what we understood:
- Your client is a building materials company operating across three regions in UP and Bihar, with roughly 3,000 dealers and a mix of personas: dealers, masons, retailers, influencers and direct customers
- Marketing today is largely offline (wall painting, posters), with a limited budget and no digital campaigns yet
- The goal is to reach about 1 lakh consumers over the next three months, mapped to about 100 dealers, starting with a pilot in one region

1. A consumer messages on WhatsApp in any language, with text or a photo

For campaigns, we can also include our ZoGrow support, a digital expert for the first three months who handles Meta campaigns, creatives and lookalike audiences. That would give your client a way to drive WhatsApp leads even with a small marketing budget.

To shape the pilot region and campaign plan, it would help to know which region your client would pilot in. Let's connect again to walk you through the solution deck and take your comments.

Thank you again for your time.

emails.body:
Dear Sandeep Ji,

Thank you for taking the time to speak with us. It was great understanding your business and the plans to expand your B2B customer base once the production capacity is scaled.

As discussed, the key areas where ZoTok can support your business are:
- WhatsApp-based customer communication: AI can handle product, price, availability and other customer queries automatically.
- Daily price & stock updates: Prices and available stock can be updated and communicated to customers through WhatsApp.
- Order automation: Orders received through text, images or handwritten notes can be captured and converted into structured orders.
- Customer-specific pricing: Different pricing can be managed based on customer/category requirements.
- Customer acquisition & reactivation: Meta/WhatsApp campaigns can help reach new B2B customers and engage your existing customer base.
- Tally integration: Support post-order communication such as invoices, ledger updates and payment reminders.
